resources.string: Checks that this phone can read a connected iPod. Nothing is written to the iPod.
Read access to the iPod granted
Choose the root of the iPod, not a folder inside it.
Choose “Allow access to the iPod”, select the iPod’s root in the file picker and confirm. iOpenPod keeps read access only.
An Apple USB device is attached but Android mounted no Volume for it. A Mac-formatted (HFS+) iPod cannot be mounted by Android; it must be restored in iTunes on Windows (FAT32).
Connect the iPod through a USB OTG adapter, then wait for Android to mount it.

iOpenPod will create a folder named iOpenPod-probe-… at the root of the iPod, write and rename about 1 MB of test files inside it, then delete the folder. Nothing else on the iPod is opened for writing. Android will ask you to choose the iPod’s root again; write access is used for this test only and is not kept.
Write access was not granted; the test did not run.
